from collections import deque

def solve(G):
    H,W=len(G),len(G[0])
    lab=[[-1]*W for _ in range(H)]; n=0
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if G[i][j] and lab[i][j]<0:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); lab[i][j]=n
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft()
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and G[x][y] and lab[x][y]<0:
                            lab[x][y]=n; q.append((x,y))
                n+=1
    mcomp={}
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if G[i][j] not in (0,1): mcomp[lab[i][j]]=G[i][j]
    # enumerate maximal all-nonzero rectangles
    rects=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if G[i][j] and (i==0 or not G[i-1][j]) and (j==0 or not G[i][j-1]):
                # max down for each width
                maxw=0
                while j+maxw<W and G[i][j+maxw]: maxw+=1
                widths=[]  # widths[h-1] = max width for height h
                w=maxw
                h=0
                while w>0:
                    h+=1
                    widths.append(w)
                    if i+h>=H: break
                    w2=0
                    while w2<w and G[i+h][j+w2]: w2+=1
                    w=w2
                for hidx,wd in enumerate(widths):
                    hh=hidx+1
                    # can't extend down: hh is max h' with widths[h'-1]>=wd
                    maxh=max(k+1 for k,v in enumerate(widths) if v>=wd)
                    if hh!=maxh: continue
                    rects.append((i,j,hh,wd))
    out=[row[:] for row in G]
    for (i,j,h,w) in rects:
        comp=lab[i][j]
        if comp not in mcomp: continue
        c=mcomp[comp]
        for a in range(i+1,i+h-1):
            for b in range(j+1,j+w-1):
                out[a][b]=c
    return out
